|game_text=Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: Until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR Peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile where X = number of characters here.
|errata_history=This is the original printed text (version 1 of 4). The image here, the release-sheet slip, prints it. The current text is [[Bane Malar, Spice Addict (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet, official text as of 11 May 2012 (slip 02)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; copy re-made 18 July 2012), page 2, slip 2 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=2 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: Until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR Peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile where X = number of characters here.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Bane_Malar_Spice_Addict.png]]) prints it. '''Document:''' release-sheet slip; no slip number, the Virtual Block 8 set mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Bane Malar, Spice Addict (Errata)]]): PC website card list, Virtual Block 8 list and Virtual master list, first archived 21 July 2012 (every capture with game text to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1281_2">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock8Type (Virtual Block 8 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR peek at the top X cards of your Force pile where X = number of characters here.” '''What changed:''' “choose: Until end of turn” is written “choose: until end of turn”, “OR Peek” is written “OR peek” and “Force Pile” is written “Force pile” (small u, p, p). Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. '''Document:''' a text list on the website, with no card image.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Bane Malar, Spice Addict (Errata 2)]]): Master List (Dark Side p. 4), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: Until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR Peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile where X = number of characters here.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-2-master.png]]) prints it. '''What changed:''' the card-list changes are undone: the Master List prints the original words of [[Bane Malar, Spice Addict]] again, character for character. It is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). '''Document:''' Master List slip; no slip number, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 8 set mark.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Bane Malar, Spice Addict (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-banemalarspiceaddict-pre.gif]]): “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may 'mindscan' by placing a card from hand on your Used Pile; choose: until end of turn Malar is power +2 and may fire a weapon twice per battle. OR Peek at the top X cards of your Force Pile where X = number of characters here.” '''What changed:''' “choose: Until end of turn” is written “choose: until end of turn”, with a small u (the card list's small u, but the Master List's “Peek” and “Force Pile”). This wording is found only on this image. '''Date:''' placed at its server upload date, 7 May 2013, when the Players Committee server received the Virtual Block 8 card images. The image may have been made earlier (Players Committee card images go back to the first Legacy releases), but nothing firmer dates it, so it is placed at the upload date (Bill, 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date; what was published last counts as current). '''Document:''' Players Committee card image; no slip number, as on the release-sheet slip, the Virtual Block 8 set mark, the whole card with the Decipher art.
